heading: Remove Text from Image Online for Free
intro: Remove unwanted text from image files you own or are authorized to edit. Clear captions, date stamps, and text overlays from pictures, then review the result before downloading.

faq.question: How do I remove text from image online?
faq.answer: Upload a supported image, continue with Google, start processing, review the result, and download it if it meets your needs.

faq.question: Is WatermarkGemini free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini is free to use. Google sign-in is required to start processing.

faq.question: What image formats are supported?
faq.answer: You can upload one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB.

faq.question: Do I need to sign in?
faq.answer: Yes. You can choose a file while signed out, but Google sign-in is required before processing starts.

faq.question: How long are uploaded files kept?
faq.answer: Uploads, results, and processing records are designed to expire after 24 hours. Temporary signed links expire sooner.

faq.question: Can I process images in bulk?
faq.answer: No. The current uploader accepts one image at a time.

faq.question: Will every background look perfect after text is removed?
faq.answer: Results can vary with the text and background. Always compare the processed image with the original before downloading.

faq.question: Can I remove copyrighted text or watermarks?
faq.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Do not remove marks to evade licensing or misrepresent authorship.
